3. UPSTREAM SOURCE
   The calibration profiles are derived from the U.S. Bureau of Labor
   Statistics Consumer Expenditure Survey (CES) Public-Use Microdata
   (PUMD), which is U.S. Government work in the public domain. The raw
   PUMD archives are not redistributed here; only derived, aggregated
   distributions are included.
